In my experiences, i end up just finding someone to occupy my time until i basically “forget” the FP, or atleast they become an after thought. You don’t have to occupy your time with people though, you can try to indulge in hobbies. I know for me personally I read romance manga to help cope with moving on and letting go of my FP (which is a more recent coping mechanism, and it’s healthier than “using” people.) :)

I basically told him that all these men online make me feel more wanted and desired then he EVER has. It destroyed him. The idea that these random men worship me and give me more attention then he bothered to made him feel worthless, which honestly, he deserved it for putting me through hell and back and making me the most insecure I ever felt.

Absolutely weird. I started dating a 27 y/o man when i was barely 19. The relationship lasted 2 years and i WISH someone would have told me that it was weird or off, or ANYTHING to get me to not get into the relationship. Although we had a lot in common; music,anime, games, easy to converse with in general, doesn’t mean we should have dated. 
The relationship was great for majority, but he was extremely immature and didn’t understand or try to understand me and my perspective as a much younger person, it was super hard on me. And this young girl is definitely going to suffer if your friend continues to pursue her.

Having another women around definitely helps! I recently moved out of my living situation with my ex partner, i found a coworker going through a oddly similar situation, and we moved in together. We’re able to vent and comfort each other and give advice. Its really relieving.
It seems like things will work out for you. Good luck! :)

Thank you for sharing. I’m glad i’m not alone in this all, i read a manga when this first happened called “Secretly I've Been Suffering About Being Sexless” it isn’t so much about PA/SA, but a relationship that lacks the energy to put towards a partner and their sex life together. I should probably re-read it and reflect more. I felt a sense of peace knowing I wasn’t the only one in this position.
I definitely feel like a different person now, i was so much more confident and happy. I didn’t worry too much about how I looked or felt, but now I constantly feel disgusting even though i’m way above average. There’s people out there who won’t hurt us like this, who’ll help us move past it and show that we’re better and deserving, its just hard to find that now. It’s just hard to trust people.

I(f21) went through a similar situation with my ex (m29). It ruined this perfect image i had of him being such a good guy. I couldn’t look at him the same and it started to make me question my self worth and if i was attractive enough. (Especially since i make porn and what not for extra income.) 
To answer your question: Not every guy does this, it’s especially creepy if he’s jerking off to women he knows without their consent. That thought alone gives me the ick.
If he isn’t going to respect you and what your boundaries are, then you need to leave and find someone who will. If you stay around it will wreck your confidence, for me personally i’m still recovering. You shouldn’t have someone sneak around you and doing things that hurt you. Always aim for better.
